g.text: Comix is a hardware-accelerated digital reader crafted for comic books, manga, and
graphic novels. Engineered with a responsive multi-panel canvas and predictive asset preloading,
the platform delivers zero-latency page turns, custom reading ergonomics (continuous webtoon
scroll or classic double-page spread), and high-fidelity color profile reproduction.
GPU-accelerated rendering engine with smooth pinch-to-zoom, optical pan, and page bending.
Smart service worker pre-buffering adjacent chapter spreads for uninterrupted reading.
Seamless switching between Japanese Right-to-Left, Left-to-Right, and Vertical Webtoon scroll.
